_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Analyze an agent tool-call log

description: Use this when the user pastes a log of an AI agent's tool calls and wants to know which calls failed, where the agent retried in a loop, which calls it repeated, or which were slow. Pass the log as trace: JSON lines or one JSON value from OpenAI messages, the Responses API, Anthropic messages, Claude Code session JSONL, MCP JSON-RPC, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry spans, or flat rows with tool, args, status or error and duration_ms. Returns findings worst first, per-tool stats, failures, retry loops, repeated calls and slow calls. Nothing is stored. It does not run the agent or any tool.

retry_min.description: Back-to-back calls to one tool that count as a retry loop or a repeated call. Default 3.

slow_ms.description: A call at or over this many milliseconds is slow. Default 10000.

trace.description: The tool-call log as text: JSON lines or one JSON value. Reads OpenAI chat messages with tool_calls, Responses API function_call items, Anthropic tool_use and tool_result blocks, Claude Code session JSONL, MCP tools/call requests and answers, LangSmith tool runs, OpenTelemetry tool spans, and flat rows with tool, args, status or error, and duration_ms or timestamps.

name: analyze_trace
title: Analyze an agent tool-call log
